schema: SLeeLa FRUCHST definition review queue v4

frequency_source.frequency_unit: occurrences per billion tokens (scaled by unilex)
frequency_source.selection: Forms NFC-normalized and stripped of edge punctuation; letterless tokens dropped; case variants merged (summed, most frequent form kept); ranked by frequency descending with code-point tie-break; first 1,000 kept. source_rank equals the re-ranked position because the upstream file is alphabetical.
limitations: Surface forms, not lemmatized headwords; case variants merged.
Web/scripture crawl (Google Corpus Crawler); not a balanced general-purpose corpus; may contain foreign-language noise.
Proper nouns (people, places, organizations) are not filtered and appear in the list.
No POS or sense labels are supplied by this source.
English, French, and Spanish definitions remain pending.
3 forms share the frequency at rank 1,000; cut by code-point order.

alignment_policy: Exact NFC headword and explicit target-language-to-Wiktionary-code mapping. Candidate POS is applied when supplied; if the frequency source has no POS, all matching POS senses are retained. All edition glosses are preserved independently, including senses without Wikidata QIDs. Shared sense-level QIDs create optional cross-edition alignment candidates only. Every candidate remains for human review; no sense is auto-selected or approved.
